data.title: Route Overview
paragraphs: The Brahmaputra is the organising force of this journey. Guwahati introduces the river at urban scale, Kaziranga reveals the floodplain as habitat, and Majuli turns water into an island culture of satras, weaving, farming, music, and seasonal adaptation.

The route then closes around Jorhat’s tea country, where plantation history and contemporary Assam meet. Wildlife is important but never allowed to dominate the entire itinerary; river, craft, food, and cultural life receive equal weight.

data.title: Journey Standards & Inclusions
items: Comfortable river, wildlife, and tea-country stays selected for location and responsible operations.
Naturalists used in Kaziranga and local cultural hosts used separately in Majuli.
Ferry and road timing kept flexible around river and weather conditions.
Wildlife drives limited to a sensible number so the journey remains culturally balanced.

data.title: Suggested Packing & Preparation
items: Light layers for warm afternoons and cooler winter mornings.
Neutral comfortable clothing for wildlife drives.
Closed shoes for village, riverbank, and estate walking.
A light rain layer during shoulder seasons.
Binoculars and a compact daypack for wildlife and birding days.

data.quote: In Assam, the river is not scenery behind the journey. It is the force that shapes habitat, settlement, ritual, agriculture, risk, and imagination.

data.title: RIVER & WILDLIFE NOTE
data.text: Kaziranga’s access is seasonal and Majuli ferry operations depend on river conditions. The journey is best treated as a flexible living-landscape itinerary rather than a rigid timetable.

data.title: Following the River East
paragraphs: The Brahmaputra gives the route a natural narrative: city, floodplain, island, and tea country each reveal a different relationship with water and land.
The strongest memories often come between headline moments, in a ferry crossing, a loom, morning mist over grassland, or tea shared on a verandah in Jorhat.

items.question: Can this route be tailored to our preferred dates and pace?
paragraphs: Yes. Every Signature itinerary is a design framework, and we adjust nights, experiences, transport, and daily intensity around your interests and travel dates.

items.question: When is the best time for this Assam route?
paragraphs: The cooler months are generally best, with Kaziranga access typically aligning with the main winter tourism season.

items.question: Are wildlife sightings guaranteed?
paragraphs: No. Drives are led by trained naturalists, but sightings remain dependent on wild animals and habitat conditions.

items.question: Can Majuli ferry schedules change?
paragraphs: Yes. River conditions can affect crossings, so the itinerary keeps enough flexibility to adapt without losing the journey’s character.

items.question: What is included when the final journey is quoted?
paragraphs: The final proposal clearly separates accommodation, private transport, guiding, arranged experiences, and any route-specific permits or specialist access.
items.listTitle: The exact inclusion list is confirmed before payment:
listItems: Chosen accommodation category and meal plan.
Confirmed guiding, hosted encounters, and ticketed experiences.
Any permits or special-access costs included in the final design.

items.question: How are reservations confirmed and scheduled?
paragraphs: Once the bespoke route, accommodation selection, and current supplier availability are approved, a 30% confirmation deposit secures the agreed services. The remaining balance is due 45 days before arrival unless the final proposal states otherwise.

items.question: What is the policy for date changes or cancellations?
paragraphs: We work directly with our partners to move dates whenever possible. Any non-refundable permits, transport tickets, or supplier penalties are passed through transparently.
listItems: 60+ days before arrival: deposit refund less confirmed non-refundable costs.
30–59 days before arrival: 50% refund or travel credit where supplier terms allow.
Less than 30 days before arrival: cancellation follows the confirmed supplier terms in your final proposal.
